{
  "case_id": "reline-01-train",
  "evidence_coverage": "COMPLETE",
  "expected_outputs": [
    "model/",
    "training-trace/",
    "predictions.npz",
    "metrics.json",
    "report.md"
  ],
  "criteria": [
    {
      "criterion": "short_training_integrity",
      "level": "L2",
      "necessary": true,
      "description": "最多20个真实optimizer step，仅用manifest中的64 train帧，生成可重载的新checkpoint/frozen graph，并对16 holdout帧原生重放。",
      "review_procedure": "人工核验训练日志、checkpoint时间/哈希、train sample_id、配置和实际模型；DeepPot重放必须与提交预测一致。禁止作者模型换名、直接拷贝labels、训练验证交叉。"
    },
    {
      "criterion": "independent_error_attribution",
      "level": "L3",
      "necessary": true,
      "description": "正确报告candidate、四个作者模型和训练均值/零力基线的raw/centered能量、per-atom bias与force-component RMSE，并按作者观测排序。",
      "verification_basis": {
        "type": "public_labeled_measurement",
        "source": "16 public holdout labels and 4 sliced author-model predictions",
        "rationale": "用于有限预算方法诊断，不是盲测或作者隐藏Gold。"
      },
      "tolerance": "所有值由评测器对同一manifest样本独立重算，rtol≤1e-6, atol≤1e-12；按固定平局容差报告最优作者模型。"
    },
    {
      "criterion": "evidence_scoped_route_decision",
      "level": "L3",
      "necessary": true,
      "description": "据训练与比较证据说明继续使用候选、作者模型或暂不选择，并正确界定可见holdout非盲、样本有限、不能证明生产精度。",
      "review_procedure": "独立审查自由文本理由与实际科学证据，确认路线选择、能量偏移和力误差解释及适用范围；不要求预填结论布尔值，也不能据自述自动授予整体PASS。",
      "verification_basis": {
        "type": "scientific_constraint",
        "source": "public 16-frame holdout labels, author-model measurements and finite training budget",
        "rationale": "可见且有限的训练/holdout证据支持条件性路线判断；不能把样本内误差比较外推为盲测、总体泛化或生产精度。仅补原有审查判据的来源字段，不改变判断规则。"
      }
    }
  ],
  "numeric_policy": {
    "training_scope": "No absolute scientific accuracy threshold; assess actual finite-budget training and use independent relative diagnostics.",
    "author_model_tie_tolerance": 1e-12
  },
  "author_model_sha256": [
    "a5eaa05beba8e11234c0891348e4336491404e998188b201f57c0abe4c35e773",
    "06fa7f85d95e9509b5195848cb6dcb982df510be29fd38a59a32b923fbf95206",
    "b21dde0c555875ea197f85270727fdc48645ca13d029fc044aa56cec57b69e8a",
    "5d7a90ac1e1f203eeb8380e1a2defc23b05c2a3c77b065af88fbf45db799503a"
  ],
  "core_scientific_adjudication": "mandatory independent review of every necessary L2/L3 criterion; agent self assertions are not scoring evidence",
  "scoring_implementation": "partial",
  "runtime_bound": true,
  "qualification_granted": false,
  "author_observations_public_not_gold": true,
  "public_baseline": "train-mean-energy and zero-force, independently computed from 64 train labels",
  "max_optimizer_steps": 20,
  "required_train_samples": 64,
  "required_holdout_samples": 16
}

review-rubric.md.data:
# 01 有限预算训练诊断审查规范

科学执行范围是64个真实训练帧、最多20 optimizer steps，以及固定16个可见holdout帧。这里的PASS仅表示按协议完成有限训练、原生预测、独立复算和有证据的风险选择；不表示生产精度、盲泛化或完整论文复现。

## short_training_integrity

人工检查DeePMD-kit TensorFlow原生配置/日志、训练样本ID、≤20更新步、checkpoint与TensorFlow frozen graph哈希链。新graph须从提交checkpoint生成；检查其不是作者模型副本。独立低权限隔离回放16帧，要求顺序、输出数值与predictions.npz相符。抄标签、抄作者预测、模型改名、帧序错、单位错、holdout混入训练均FAIL。

## independent_error_attribution

评分器从公开holdout labels、公开四模型预测和64帧训练数组独立复算candidate/author/baseline各自的每原子raw与centered energy RMSE、energy bias和force-component RMSE。energy offset只改变raw误差及bias，不改变centered误差。组件RMSE不能换成每原子力向量范数。报告应正确给出作者最佳项和平局处理。

## evidence_scoped_route_decision

人工审阅自由文本理由和路线选择是否由误差排序支持。必须明确holdout标签可见、验证非盲、数据有限，不证明生产势质量；不得只填布尔值代替科学解释。训练失败可作为负结果如实报告，但不能把缺少真实执行伪装成完成。

所有必要criterion都需实际证据及逐项PASS裁决。当前无预制trusted review或自动整体PASS；缺人工审查时保持REVIEW_REQUIRED/no reward。
